entries.label: FI
entries.description: Flow Indicator — instrument bubble (circle) with letters F + I stacked inside; local visual flow reading with no transmission or control.

entries.label: FT
entries.description: Flow Transmitter — instrument bubble with F + T inside; converts a flow measurement into a remote signal.

entries.label: FIC
entries.description: Flow Indicating Controller — instrument bubble with F + I + C stacked; indicates flow and drives a control output.

entries.label: FR
entries.description: Flow Recorder — instrument bubble with F + R inside; records flow history (trend or chart).

entries.label: FRC
entries.description: Flow Recording Controller — instrument bubble with F + R + C inside; records flow and drives a control output.

entries.label: FE
entries.description: Flow Element — primary sensing element (orifice plate, venturi, coriolis body) drawn as a tag circle or inline block on the pipe.

entries.label: FV
entries.description: Flow Valve — final control element driven by a flow loop; drawn as a control valve body with an FV tag bubble.

entries.label: FQ
entries.description: Flow Totalizer/Quantity — instrument bubble with F + Q inside; integrates flow into cumulative volume or mass.

entries.label: PI
entries.description: Pressure Indicator — instrument bubble with P + I; local pressure gauge, no transmission.

entries.label: PT
entries.description: Pressure Transmitter — instrument bubble with P + T; converts pressure into a remote signal.

entries.label: PIC
entries.description: Pressure Indicating Controller — instrument bubble with P + I + C; indicates pressure and drives a control output.

entries.label: PR
entries.description: Pressure Recorder — instrument bubble with P + R; records pressure history.

entries.label: PDI
entries.description: Pressure Differential Indicator — instrument bubble with P + D + I; displays differential pressure across a restriction (e.g. filter).

entries.label: PDT
entries.description: Pressure Differential Transmitter — instrument bubble with P + D + T; transmits differential pressure (common on orifice-plate flow loops).

entries.label: PSV
entries.description: Pressure Safety Valve — spring-loaded relief valve glyph (body with angled bonnet and spring) tagged PSV; opens on over-pressure.

entries.label: PCV
entries.description: Pressure Control Valve — self-acting (usually) control valve body tagged PCV; maintains upstream or downstream pressure.

entries.label: LI
entries.description: Level Indicator — instrument bubble with L + I; local level reading.

entries.label: LT
entries.description: Level Transmitter — instrument bubble with L + T; converts a level measurement into a remote signal.

entries.label: LIC
entries.description: Level Indicating Controller — instrument bubble with L + I + C; indicates level and drives a control output.

entries.label: LSH
entries.description: Level Switch High — instrument bubble with L + S + H; contact switch asserting on high level.

entries.label: LSL
entries.description: Level Switch Low — instrument bubble with L + S + L; contact switch asserting on low level.

entries.label: LG
entries.description: Level Gauge (sight glass) — external tube or magnetic gauge beside a vessel tagged LG; visual-only level display.

entries.label: TI
entries.description: Temperature Indicator — instrument bubble with T + I; local temperature reading (dial thermometer or similar).

entries.label: TT
entries.description: Temperature Transmitter — instrument bubble with T + T; converts temperature into a remote signal.

entries.label: TIC
entries.description: Temperature Indicating Controller — instrument bubble with T + I + C; indicates temperature and drives a control output.

entries.label: TE
entries.description: Temperature Element — primary sensing element (thermocouple or RTD) drawn as a small circle tagged TE, inline on the pipe or inserted into a well.

entries.label: TW
entries.description: Thermowell — protective sheath for a temperature element, drawn as a small stub penetrating the pipe wall tagged TW.

entries.label: TR
entries.description: Temperature Recorder — instrument bubble with T + R; records temperature history.

entries.label: AI
entries.description: Analysis Indicator — instrument bubble with A + I; local analyzer display (pH, conductivity, O2, etc.).

entries.label: AT
entries.description: Analysis Transmitter — instrument bubble with A + T; transmits an analytical measurement to the DCS.

entries.label: HS
entries.description: Hand Switch — instrument bubble with H + S; operator-initiated manual switch (local or DCS).

entries.label: XV
entries.description: Shutdown/On-Off Valve — control valve body tagged XV; typically solenoid- or actuator-driven for ESD or block duty.

entries.label: centrifugal_pump
entries.description: Centrifugal pump — circle with a trapezoidal discharge pointing up or out; the standard rotodynamic pump glyph.

entries.label: positive_displacement_pump
entries.description: Positive displacement pump — rectangle or chambered body with piston/gear internals indicated; used for metering and high-viscosity service.

entries.label: compressor
entries.description: Centrifugal compressor — trapezoidal body (often with 'C' or vane marks inside) with inlet and discharge nozzles; gas service.

entries.label: tank_vertical
entries.description: Vertical storage tank — tall cylinder with flat or dished top and bottom, typically atmospheric service.

entries.label: vessel_horizontal
entries.description: Horizontal pressure vessel — cylinder on its side with dished (2:1 elliptical or hemispherical) heads; separator or drum duty.

entries.label: column
entries.description: Distillation/absorber column — tall vertical cylinder with internal tray lines or packed-bed hatching; multiple side nozzles for feed, reflux, reboiler.

entries.label: shell_tube_heat_exchanger
entries.description: Shell-and-tube heat exchanger — horizontal cylinder (shell) with internal tube bundle indicated; four nozzles (two shell-side, two tube-side).

entries.label: plate_heat_exchanger
entries.description: Plate heat exchanger — stacked-plate rectangle with diagonal hatching; compact liquid-liquid service.

entries.label: fired_heater
entries.description: Fired heater/furnace — rectangular or cylindrical body with burner glyphs at the base and a stack on top; combusts fuel to heat process fluid.

entries.label: air_cooler
entries.description: Air-cooled heat exchanger (fin-fan) — horizontal tube bundle over a circular fan glyph; cools process fluid with ambient air.

entries.label: gate_valve
entries.description: Gate valve — two opposed filled triangles meeting at a point (bowtie) with a vertical stem and handle; full-bore block valve.

entries.label: globe_valve
entries.description: Globe valve — bowtie body with a filled disk/sphere at the junction indicating the plug; throttling service.

entries.label: check_valve
entries.description: Check valve — bowtie or circle-with-arrow showing a swing or ball element; permits flow in one direction only.

entries.label: ball_valve
entries.description: Ball valve — bowtie body with a central circle (the ball); quarter-turn block or on/off service.

entries.label: butterfly_valve
entries.description: Butterfly valve — bowtie body with a diagonal line through the junction representing the disc; quarter-turn throttling or isolation.

entries.label: control_valve
entries.description: Control valve — bowtie body with a diaphragm or piston actuator drawn on top (domed cap with stem); modulated by a control loop.

entries.label: three_way_valve
entries.description: Three-way valve — bowtie/globe body with a third port branching off (T-shape); diverts or mixes flow.

entries.label: process_pipe
entries.description: Process pipe — solid continuous line connecting equipment and valves; the default process fluid line.

entries.label: electric_signal
entries.description: Electric signal — line with short perpendicular dashes or slashes at regular intervals; connects instruments to DCS/PLC.

entries.label: pneumatic_signal
entries.description: Pneumatic signal — line with repeated double cross-hatches (//) along its length; instrument air to valve actuators.

entries.label: capillary
entries.description: Capillary tube — line of small uniform dots or short dashes; filled-system temperature or remote-seal pressure connection.

entries.label: off_page_connector
entries.description: Off-page connector — pentagonal/home-plate or circular tag at a line terminus indicating the line continues on another drawing; labeled with destination sheet/tag.

notes: Curated minimal starter set for ISA-5.1 — v0. Covers the most common instrument letter combinations (flow/pressure/level/temperature/analysis), core equipment glyphs, the seven ValveType literals plus three-way, and the five line/connector styles. Extend as Phase 1 eval identifies misses.
